title: Tailr Core translation
description: A translation file (Catalogue → Translations). The keys are the original Dutch texts; keep placeholders such as {name}.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion in your editor.

name.description: Name in the language menu, e.g. "Deutsch". Needed for a new language; not for en.

dateLocale.description: Locale for dates and numbers, e.g. de-DE. Default: the language code.

messages.description: Texts of the web app and the gateway: original English text → translation.

plugins.description: Texts of installed plugins, per plugin id: original text → translation.

additionalProperties.description: Original English text → translation. Keep the keys exactly as they are, and keep placeholders such as {name} unchanged. Empty values are skipped.

anyOf.description: A translation file for Tailr Core (Catalogue → Translations). Keys starting with _ are comments.
A flat file with only texts: original Dutch text → translation.
